// GOVERNANCE LAYER · SBT PARLIAMENT ON BNB SMART CHAIN AetherRing · AetherGovernance

Rule the reserve with soulbound rank

Aether is an SBT-governed on-chain parliament on BNB Smart Chain. Three chambers — Council, Parliament, Elders — weighted voting by 14-rank soulbound identity, and a Safe multisig treasury. Inside that treasury sits the loop's strategic asset: the long-term $SPARK reserve. Influence is earned and bound to your soul; $SPARK buys fuel, never votes.

02 / STRUCTURE THREE CHAMBERS

Power divided, so power behaves

Legislation, review and veto sit in separate hands. A proposal must survive all three — plus a public timelock — before the treasury moves a single wei.

Council

EXECUTIVE · LEGALITY & BUDGET

Runs the day-to-day and reviews proposals for legality, budget fit and charter alignment before anything reaches a vote.

  • Proposal admission & framing
  • Emergency pause (never spend)
  • Elected through AetherElection

Parliament

LEGISLATIVE · WEIGHTED VOTE

The citizen body. Votes are weighted by soulbound rank on AetherRing — contribution compounds into voice, capital cannot.

  • 14 rank tiers → vote weight
  • Temperature checks off-chain via Havix
  • Quorum by citizens, not by token supply

Elders

GUARDIAN · CHARTER VETO

The constitutional brake. Elders may veto only for charter violations — and every veto must carry written reasons, on-chain.

  • Veto power, narrowly scoped
  • Written, auditable veto reasons
  • Guardians of the Spark reserve mandate
03 / IDENTITY AETHERRING SBT

14 ranks of soulbound standing

AetherRing mints non-transferable rank tokens. Tap a rank to feel how weight scales — and remember: there is no shop that sells rank 14.

×8

A working citizen: proposals carry momentum.

SOULBOUND MEANS SOULBOUND Rank tokens are bound at mint: no transfer, no delegation market, no lending against voting power. Sybil resistance comes from Havix's vouch-and-reputation layer — identity you cannot buy, only build.

05 / TREASURY THE SPARK RESERVE

A vault audited by every citizen

The Spark reserve is Aether's strategic mandate: fuel banked for the long term, released deliberately. Every movement is a timelocked call that anyone can read — including the AI's liquidity operations, which run strictly inside charter bounds defined here.

3 / 5
Safe multisig threshold — treasury execution

Any three of five signers — chambers, elected officers and chartered AI — can execute a timelocked call. Nobody moves the reserve alone.

SPARK
long-term reserve mandate
  • ▸ Bank: subscriptions flow in and are held, not dumped
  • ▸ Release: liquidity operations for Engine's app economy — charter-capped at ≤5% of the reserve per year
  • ▸ AI: may rebalance — inside the charter, under veto
